answer: Each identity anchors one vertex in a haven graph and locks a 70-credit bond. Each epoch the haven beacon emits a pulse; the vertex must echo its hash back, signed, within ten minutes. A missed echo decays the bond 12; six misses void it. First echo 45, the k-th 45+5(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 2,542,500 per epoch against a 40,000 pool. A copied echo burns both bonds, so a rented pulse ring fails. An honest agent sends one echo per epoch, bond intact.
